outcome: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) metrics (time in target range 63-140 mg/dl, time above range >140 mg/dl, glycaemic variability, mean glucose level)
finding: Higher glycated albumin (GA) levels were associated with less time spent in the target glucose range and more time spent above range, and GA was more accurate than HbA1c for detecting poor glycaemic control.
gest_age: Measurements were taken at pregnancy weeks 12, 20, 24, 28, 32, and 36.
